tei:div.tei:p: tshordoX6tram̐sto kru /ne sko— rtswa ke 8 t+t+waṃdri‘ rnodī+o rilashā rke ’ khuge 4ra ṅgā tshomi mo’ ri skyu— shā sgroṣedītshotrīrtsohūṃ—snyepaṃrgo statshe/zhi 〉⑫༄ trī/hūṃ3 sh+tsa 4kho kro dzo ༷4 —ridzārdu ri rtsi‘ ṭ+wāṃ ra 'i ri—gangh+ruloX rī rme rna paje jitshotrī glo dze māṃXrme/byā— sku4 nisduchu ske phro — ༷ sh+lau—ne+erdorkotshachortse ji/ thongo lo 7 rdzo ne tsho mgar rtse lcags lo rgyal sras ༷r+sāri ṇ+ḍaṃ / bi mgaraspre'u gzhon ni spyi lo 197wo'i ljang mdogagista— sne ‘dzā rnamopaphroba'i ston ljongs shig la brtse chen ashā 〉k+ṣ-igyi dz+wa‘ ze 7 bka'adrinalasangu skad kyi dbyangs rta dang pomitsho be+e thol sas kyis btsems sgo ne kyi rtso(blo lasgron/ khorang chung dus nasabazung rig gnasal la 4 ge — — tsho —rteme datsozhing pha skad ladung ba'i 'brog phrug rnal ma ldoko 0 sna —/ sgo— zhigaste/ kholang rgyalagyikhengasasem4dbenal phrag 4spu ro dogagi bsam ngan med par lam ga 'di nayonarage ( ༵rta dwo ༄pa'iphyugasardzidakyu4mazhig yin pa smramidagos/chi tsho gyi rngo — ā+on yang/ dam pa rnam4kyis batsho ba'i snying tre rtso 3 stob4labartsona'agrugakyi4tshonartsibyug4na4lamol ༄9 ṣ+ka'adod gang ltar/ kho'i snyan deb thog mar+sāspre 〉 sna sto ri 〈〈rkangarje4dmarapo〉〉zhe4partsomarigagigarastega.oṃ ju ju stengadu bsgyur ba'i gom khadang po yin kho4nu zi ru ——ོ d+kurī byu — rdardzi shwe shug4miro kyi4zhi bde'i 'tsho ba skyong thug byu — ༷ṭaṃsna rdu/ ne — skru rte༄ hotsa ṇ+ḍaṃ gidzitre4 4 ji kāshi nga lke྾ga
rkang rjes dmar po/lcags blo rgyal sras kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chaganyam chung ba'i glu skad rnal ma/ (1)le'u dang po/ (1)phugs bsam gyi rol mo/ (2)spobs sems kyi gad rgyangs/ (3)skal bzang nyi ma'i drod khol/ (4)nga'i sems kyi phyed ka (5)nga'i spun grogs tsho/ (7)gangs phrug gi gdung 'bod/ (10)bden don dkar po/ (11)rdzi bo'i las dbang / (13)byams ldan a ma'i bka' drin/ (14)nga 'tsho mi 'dod/ (15)skyo thal/ (16)nga 'di ltar 'ongs/ (17)brel tshub/ (18)mes po'i rgyud 'dzin/ (19)le'u gnyis pa/ (20)mchod pa'i me tog (21)sems kyi kha btags/ (22)dang sems kyi glu sgra (23)1

mnyam du 'gro/ (24)sems kyi rang sgra (25)nga tsho'i 'gro rogs/ — (27)dran mgur/ (28)tshe ring sgrol ma/ (29)do nub kyi phyir dran/ ci (30)skyo sems/ ci (31)sring chung ma/ (32)bslu brid/ (33)lug rdzi bu mo/ (34)gangs ri'i ljongs kyi dar rgud/ (35)le'u gsum pa/ (36)rkang rjes dmar po/ tsho (37)rten 'brel gyi mchod pa/ (38)brtse ba'i chags 'jig (39)rlung khrod kyi sems pa/ (40)gangs phrug khyu gcig gi spobs pa/ (41)'tsho ba'i ljang mdog (42)bzhud la nye ba'i sbra nag (44)gshog mthun bya khyu/ (45)gshed ma nag po/ (46)grogs po tsho/ mdun du skyod cig (47)do nub kyi mi lam/ (48)gnas 'gro ma'i las dbang / (49)2

pha sa gangs kyi ra ba/ (50)sgo khyi'i las dbang / (51)sems kyi me tog tshom bu/ (52)las dbang gi 'tsho grogs/ (55)mi rtag rgyu ma'i lang tsho (56)mi tshe zhig gi brgyud rim/ (57)bod pa'i mdzes ma (58)rnam shes dang be+em po/ (59)a pha sems ma skyo/ (60)

nyam chung pa'i glu skad rnal ma/da wagasar byung rtsom pa po mgar lcags lo rgyal sras sam spre'u gzhon gyi sngon 'gro'i tshab tu gleng ba/— spyir dus rabs gsar pa'i 'gros dang nye bar bsdongs pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di na snyan ngag pa tshad ldan du bsngags pa rnams dang gsar skyes snyan ngag pa mang po zhig gi ngag las 'phos pa'i don ldan gyi gdam rnam pa sna tshogs shig dbyar dus kyi 'brug sgra ldir ba dang nye bar mtshungs shing /kho bos kyang gtam 'di dag la sems 'phreng ba'i mi rkyang dbul bo zhig gi ming byang khur nas kha ba'i kha dog dang snyan ngag gi bgro gleng la rab tu zhen pa'i rkyen gyis pham kha brgya phrag gi rdog khres kyis mnan pa las byung ba'i shugs ring zhig gi tshab tu 〈〈rkang rjes dmar po 〉〉zhes pa'i deb chung 'di phul na yang skyon mi nyung ba zhig mchis srid na yang / bgrang bya du ma'i ring la nor nag gi rmig rjes dang mtho sgang gi ri sul nas rim gyis shog bu dang smyug gu kho bo'i grogs su gyur zhing / lo ngo mang po zhig gi ring la mthong thos rnal ma'i dra rgya dang sems pa dmar po'i yang gting nas mched pa'i skad cha 'di dag khyed cag gis mthong tshe/ drang bden gyi lam bu zhig dang bde skyid kyi gnas tshang zhig ston par snying thag pa nas re ba zhu/sna mang shes bya'i gter mdzod kyi khrod nas kho'i dga' phyogs gtso bo ni snyan ngag yin la/ zhen phyogs gtso bo ni brtse dung yin/ kho bos bgrang bya lnga'i ring la btsal ba'i 〈〈rkang rjes dmar po 〉〉zhes pa'i deb chung 'di dpyod ldan klog pa po dag gi spyan lam du bstar ba dang lhan du rtsom pa po'i rang 1

gshis dang sems khams sogs ci 'dra zhig yin pa rang bzhin gyis tshor thub pa yin/'o/ 'di ni gsar skyes rtsom pa po lcags lo rgyal sras kyis brtson pa lhod med byas pa'i 'bras bu zhig dang / thog ma'i rgyal kha zhig gi dbu khyud cig kyang yin pas/ nged cag klogadzhapa po yongs kyis kho'i snyan deb dpe skrun byed thub par rten 'brel zhu 'os pa ma zad/ da dung gangs ri'i 'jig rten la bzhag pa'i rkang rjes re re la smon 'dun gyi rlung rta spur ba red/ shes ldan dag gi spyan sngaranga'agrim pa'i sta gon du zhugs par 'di ltar/ khyed kyi snyan deb thog ma rten 'brel zhu b.radzha phul ba dge gyur cig/ mgar rtse 'bum phyug rgyal nas/

le'u dang po/phugasabasam gyi rolamo/'jagalomi srid pa'i phugs bsam gyi glu skad re re/smag rumagyi btsan rdzong brgal nasagyer yong /gang ltar/ rol dbyangasasnyan mos/nged tshang gi gti mug la phamakhabyin/

phugs bsam gyi rol mo/pha lo'i bka' drin brjed pa'i bsam ngan med//pha mas sdang mig ston pa'i spyod tshul med//pha gzhis bde 'jags bskrun pa'i gdeng tshod med//pha don bu yis bsgrub pa'i sems pa yod//ma nor lam mchog ston pa'i slob dpon med//ma rig rmongs pa sel ba'i shes rab med//ma 'ongs bde sdug rtogs pa'i mkhyen rgya med//ma yi drin lan 'jal ba'i sems pa yod//rang rigs la rgya gleng ba'i spobs pa med//rang sde phu nu skyong ba'i 'jon thang med//rang srog rtswa chur brje ba'i glen rtags med//rang sems dung las dkar ba'i sems pa yod//'dzoms pa'i pha mar phul ba'i legs skyes yin//'dzoms pa'i ming sring spro ba'i dgod sgra yin//'dzoms pa'i grogs por smras pa'i snying gtam yin//'dzoms par dga' ba nga yi 'dzum mdangs yin//2

spobasasems kyi gad rgyangs/mig zung gangs rtser bsrings pa'i sprel gzhon 'khyam pos//kha char bu yug 'tshub pa'i gru zur zhig nas//re ba'i dbyangs rta snyan mo lhod kyes 'then te//'dun pa'i me tog gsar ba gangs la gtor 'dod//rjes su lus na zur za'i tshig gis mnar yong //sngon du song na mi khas lus po bsreg yong // —dus rgyun bshad yams 'ug pa'i than skad 'khor yang //spobs sems snying gi khrag rtsa 'jags thabs mi 'dug/phrag dog me ltar 'bar ba'i so kha 'di nas//'phya smod rdul rlung nag po shugs kyis g.yugs kyang //zhum med spobs pas bzhengs pa'i rkang rjes dmar po//mag mog 'jig rten srid pa'i grong la 'jog 'dod//mgo bo gnam la btegs pa'i mkhas pa la las/rigs zhen rol mo dkrol ba'i 'khyam po bdag la//nyam chung phyugs rdzi zhes pa'i dman sar 'bebs kyang //spobs pa'i gad rgyangs sgrog bzhin mdun du bskyod do//3

skal bzang nyi ma'i drod khol/skyid pa'i nyi gzhon dang po mkha' dbyings nas 'dzum bzhin//skyid pa'i 'od zer 'jam po 'jig rten 'dir 'phro dus//skyid sdug mnyam du rol ba'i mi yul gyi khams 'dir//skyid pa'i dpal la rol ba'i skal bzang zhig bslebs song /deng 'dir gangs ri'i gzi 'od lam lam du 'tsher bzhin//chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan mo lhang lhang du grags dus//brjid ldan gangs ri'i ljongs kyi mi rigs 'di'i dgod sgra//mtsho chen khri shor rgyal mo'i rlabs rgyun las 'phur song //nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mkha' nas shar ba yi skabs su//rdzogs ldan dus rabs gsar pa'i glu sgra 'di thos pas//skya ser pho mos dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs re ston bzhin//bskal bzang nyin mo bslebs pa'i dga' ston la rol byung //gang skyid dbyar zla bzhi ba'i dus bzang dang lhan du//gang snyan lha bya khu los gsung dbyangs de sgrog dus//gang yag me tog sna brgya'i skyed tshal na 'tsho ba'i//gang zag dad ldan 'gro ba'i 'tsho ba 'di skyid ang //4

nga'i sems kyi phyed ka.a ma/skra nag 'dabs kyi chung chung lus po byams kyis bskyangs pa'i ma yum gyis/dka' sdug 'tsho ba'i bye thang 'grim nas gom pa'i 'degs 'jog 'khyar ma 'khyor//lang tsho'i ljon pa lo zlas zas kyang nga tsho'i ched du 'bad cing 'bungs//'di ltar rgas pa'i a ma'i bka' drin nyam chung bu ngas ci ltar 'jal//dzi5pha/sbra khyim nang na 'od du 'tsher ba'i bu chung bdag gi a pha yis//kho bo'i dmar chung sha las mched pa'i nga dang ming sring dag gi phyir//sems 'gyu phra mo 'tsho bar gtad pas mi tshe'i skra lo dkar por gyur//bu ngas da dung a pha'i bka' drin smyug gu'i rtse nas 'di ltar bzhur//a brgya/da phrug cig gi sdug bsngal khur nas slob grwa'i sgo them gang rung brgal//brtson pa'i me lce drag tu 'bar bas bcu phrag rig pa'i dpal la rol//khang brtsegs mthon po mkha' ru bsnyegs pa'i rgyang thag ring ba'i sa cha nas//sku tshe mi 'jig ri bzhin brtan par nga tshos smon pa'i rlung rta spur//ming sring cho/mi tshe sngon ma'i las 'bras shig gis pha khyim gcig la lhan du 'dzoms//drin chen pha ma'i byams brtse'i 'og nas lang tsho'i gnyom lag rim gyis rgyas//5

nga'i spun grogasatsho/che ning dbang rgyal/ gnag snum skra lo ring ba‘gangs ri'i seng phrug/snyan 'gyur pi wang dkrol ba mon yul khu lo//khyed kyis dpal gyi lang tsho'i glu skad khyer nas//spobs pa'i rdog bro 'khrab bzhin mdun du bskyod song //'bum phyug rgyal/smag rum mun pa rgod pa'i batren rdzong de nas//mi zhum spobs pa'i mgo bo yar la btegs te// zungs khrag dmar po'i mchod pa glu ru gyer bzhin//rtsom pa'i gar stegs steng du 'gro bar brtsams song //rta mgrin che ringaka dran rig lha mo dgod pa'i 'dzum dang bcas te//snyan ngag thar thor lcags smyug rtsal gyis bris 'dug/brtson sems rma klong sngon mo'i rgyun dang 'grogs te//mi tshe'i rkang rjes drod mo gangs la 'jog 'dod//dpal 'bumazul/brtson pa'i rta mchog rgod po lcag gis skul bzhin//rig pa'i bgrod lam 'tshol ba'i stag bu snyan sras//thol byung snyan ngag 'bri ba'i pir shog bar nas//7

'u gnyis sems kyi 'dun pa gcig tu 'dres song //bkra stobs/dang po khyed kyi snang ba 'brong las mtho dus//'khyam po nga rang khyed la 'phrad kyang ma 'dod//da lta snying gtam dmar po gcig tu 'dres dus//'u gnyis pha gcig spun dang he bag mi 'dug/'jigs med/lus bo g.yang dkar lug khyu'i rjes na yod kyang //grogs la bcangs pa'i brtse ba rum du bcug yod//glu skad thar thor skyi ser rlung la skur bzhin//sems pa shes rig me sgrotog ldum rar 'khor 'dug/che3nga don 'grub/gshis 'jam lang tshos mdzes pa'i grogs po chung chung //kyag kyog 'tsho ba'i lam phran dog mo 'di nas//ma mjal lo zla ring mo ji ltar 'das kyang //brtse ba mi 'gyur rdotre rje brag la brkos yod//bde mchog rgyal/'od mdangs rab tu 'tsher ba'i slob grwa'i gling nas//shes bya'i me tog 'thu ba'itsha bo khyed kyi sa//le lo rnam g.yeng de yi mgo bo bcad de// —rig pa'i gshog zung brkyangs te slob la brtson cig/rta mgrin skyabs/ka kha'i dbyangs rta 'phur ba'i slob grwa'i gling nas//shes rig me hog pad ma'i bcud la rol bzhin//8
byams ldan pha ma'i brtse ba sems su bsgoms nas//dran gdung mig cha'i phreng ba sa ru thor song //tsho — raX

gangasaphrug gi gdung 'bod/mun pa rim gyis sangs pa'i skya rengs dang 'grogs nas//nyi zla mnyam du shar ba'i 'jig rten zhig 'tshol phyir//glu skad thar thor pha ri'i brag cha ru 'khor yang //'u cag 'dun pa'i lam na spyang ltogs 'gas bsgugs 'dug/zhogs pa'i skya rengs sngo bsangs mkha' mtha' ru bkra yang //re ba'i nyi zla ma shar skyo snang gis btums pa'i//mig zung rgyang la cer ba'i 'u cag gi spobs pa//rlung rta yar 'phur zhig gi sne mo ru btegs yod//gshog zung lto la gtad pa'i khrung khrung gi khyu tshogs//lhags rlung ngar kha rgod pa'i so kha ru brgyud nas//nyi zla'i grong la 'phur ba'i re 'dun zhig yod kyang //mdun gyi bgrod lam sprin pa lang long gis bcad 'dug/nga dang gangs phrug stong gi pir rtse las bzhur ba'i//'tshol snyeg bzhud lam bcad pa'i smre sngags kyi dbyangs rta//'dzad med snyan ngag skyur bo'i zhing khams shig brgyud nas//gangs ri'i sul nas bstud ger lho phyogs su 'phur song //10

bden don dkar po/dpon po'i go sa thob rnams mthon po yang min la/dkar nag phyugs rjes 'brang kun dma' mo yang min pas//gang ltar drang bden lam nas mdun phyogs su bskyod na//ma 'ongs bod pa gling 'di'i sngon thon du 'gyur nges//rig pa'i skyed tshal 'grim pa dbul bo yang min la//rgyal 'jog sho khang nyul ba phyug po yang min pas//gang ltar mdun lam gsar ba'i 'od stong la rems na//ma 'ongs bod pa gling 'di'i sngon thon du 'gyur nges//smyug thogs gzhan skyon gleng mkhan mkhas pa yang min la//nyam chung rang skyon brjod mkhan blun po yang min pas//gang ltar bcu phrag rig pa'i nying bcud la rol na//ma 'ongs bod pa gling 'di'i sngon thon du 'gyur nges//rgya skad da dig smra ba sngon thon yang min la//bod skad rnam dag mi shes rjes lus kyang min pas//gang ltar mes po'i shul bzhag spyi gtsug tu bkur na//ma 'ongs bod pa gling 'di'i sngon thon du 'gyur nges//11

nang dme'i khrag la rngam pa dpa' bo yang min la//kun la brtsi bkur byed pa glen pa yang min pas//gang ltar zhi bde'i ngang gis 'tsho ba zhig bskyal na//ma 'ongs bod pa gling 'di'i sngon thon du 'gyur nges//slob mas du chang spyod pa yon tan yang min la//rgan pos ka kha slob pa ngo tsha yang min pas//gang ltar rig pa'i gnas la 'bad brtson re byas na//ma 'ongs bod pa gling 'di'i sngon thon du 'gyur nges//12

rdzi bo'i lasadabang /mtho sgang kha ba'i ri zom na//gnag phyugs nor gyi rmig rjes na//mi tshe'i rin thang bor ba 'di//nga dang rdzi bo'i las dbang red//yangs shing skyid pa'i rtswa thang na//lug khyu stong gi mtha' 'khor na//gti mug gnyid du yur ba 'di//nga dang rdzi bo'i las dbang red//rnying zhing hrul ba'i slog khug na//grang reg tsub mo'i mche bar na//'ur cha'i sne mor 'jus pa 'di//nga dang rdzi bo'i las dbang red//dus rabs shig gi dkyogs mtshams na//rmongs rtul dpa' bo'i mtshon kha na//lo rgyus khrag la 'dres pa 'di//nga dang rdzi bo'i las dbang red//13

byams ldan ama'i bka' drin/ru sbra mthing sprug gru bzhi'i gru zur na//skra lo dung ltar dkar ba'i a ma lags//khyed kyis dka' tshegs sdug yus du ma'i khrod//nga dang ming sring brgyad po byams kyis bskyangs//drin lan 'jal thub med pa'i drin can ma//ngal gso med par dgung lo drug cur son//nged cag ming sring rnams kyi bde skyid ched//dka' sdug stong gi mi tshe bzhud la nye//dga' sdug 'tsho bar rol ba'i 'jig rten nas//nga rang ma dang lhan du gnas kyang rung //sems kyi 'khyer so dmar po'i hrag bar nas//a ma'i dka' tshegs dran nas sems pa skyo//a ma'i bka' drin dran thengs re re bzhin//dbang med mig chu'i phreng ba sa ru thor//a ma'i mi tshe dgung gi nyi ma la// gza' dang sprin gyis bar chad med par smon//14

nga 'tsho mi 'dod/kha ba yi zhing khams 'di na//yab mes kyi srol bzang dben pas//dus rabs kyi rlung kha 'di las//bu chung nga 'tsho na mi 'dod// phyugs skyong gi yul gru 'di na//shes rig gi 'od snang dben pas// — nor gnag gi mig rjes 'ded bzhin//bu chung nga 'tsho na mi 'dod//rmi lam gyi 'jig rten 'di na//rtag brtan gyi 'tsho ba dben pas// kyag kyog gi lam phran 'di gar//bu chung nga 'tsho na mi 'dod// 2006 6 7la bris/15

skyo thal/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir srin po'i dug rlangs phog thal//gzhung drang bod mi'i sems kyi snying rje bros thal//rtswa chu gnyis kyi don du rtsod gleng byas thal//'di dag bsams na bu nga'i sems pa skyo thal//stag shar gzhon nus don med rgya srang nyul thal//sman chung bu mos lus kyi rgyan cha spangs thal//mes po'i srol bzang thams cad 'di ltar dor thal//'di dag bsams na bu nga'i sems pa skyo thal//khrel med dpon 'a gas 'bangs mi sdug la gtad thal//shes ldan slob mas srol rgyun rigaganas spangs thal//la rgya'i rta mchog rgod po'i gom kha lhod thal//'di dag bsams na bu nga'i sem4pa skyo thal//rnam dag btsun pa mdzes ma'i 'dzum gyis bslus thal//sems pa nyon mongs dug lnga'i klung du 'dzul thal//'khor ba sdug bsngal zer bzhin 'khor bar 'khyam thal//'di dag bsams na bu nga'i sems pa skyo thal//16

nga 'di ltar 'ongs/byams ldan ma yi byang khog brgyud nas// mi yul 'di ru ltad mor slebs dus//mi rigs 'di yi nyams rgud mthong nas//mi 'chi nad yams snying la phog song //mi khom gnag phyugs rjes su 'brangs nas//mi tshe'i phyed ka ri nas bor song //mi mdzes slog pa hrul bo gyon nas/mi rkyang sems pa ri nas rgas song //mi lo nyer lnga'i sgo them brgal nas//mi chos sgrub pa'i phugs bsam rnyed byung //mi zhum spobs r+pāmatho ru btegs te//mi dman rig bcu'i bdud rtsi btung ngo //mi rtag 'khor ba'i chos nyid bsam na//mi bzod na zug glo bur langs shing /mi tshe'i dbugs rgyun ma chad bar du//mi 'dug rig pa'i gnas la brtson 'dod//17

brela'atshub/zhogs par 'bri mo'i ngur sgra thos pa'i dus//g.yu byur rgyan du btags pa'i bu mo tsho//dud smug mkha' ru 'phyur ba'i sbra nang nas//thul dkar 'bri mo bzho bar brel 'tshub langs//gser mdog nyi ma ri rtser 'phags pa'i dus//'ur cha'i sne mor 'ju ba'i rdzi bo tshos//mi gtsang lci dri 'thul ba'i lhas ra nas//phyugs zog ri la 'ded par brel 'tshub langs//drod 'jam nyi 'od sa gzhir khyab pa'i dus//bsam med lo na chung ba'i byis pa tsho//rtswa ljang me tog ldem pa spang thang nas//dga' spro'i rtsed mor g.yeng bar brel 'tshub langs//mtshan mo sgo khyi'i zug skad sgrog pa'i dus//'dod pa'i brtse dung 'tshol ba'i gzhon nu tsho//mag mog zla ba 'dzum pa'i 'od ngogs su//snying grogs bu mo 'phrad par brel 'tshub langs//18

mes po'i rgyud 'dzin/lhun stug gangs ris bskor ba'i gangs can na//lhag bsam 'dab ma grol ba'i gangs phrug tsho//byams brtse'i gzi byin 'tshol ba'i khyod dang nga //mkhas mdzangs mes po dag gi rgyud 'dzin yin//kha ba'i me tog bzhad pa'i bsil ljongs na//drang bden gnas lugs skyong ba'i gangs phrug tsho//zhi bde'i bya khyu 'tshol ba'i khyod dang nga //dpa' ldan mes po dag gi rgyud 'dzin yin//snod bcud dpal gyis phyug pa'i gangs ljongs na//mdun bskyod las la brel ba'i gangs phrug tsho//la rgya'i rta phor bzhon pa'i khyod dang nga //dpyod ldan mes po dag gi rgyud 'dzin yin//lugs gnyis dar rgyas che ba'i sman ljongs na//shes bya'i me tog 'thu ba'i gangs phrug tsho//rig pa'i skyed tshal 'grim pa'i khyod dang nga //brtson ldan mes po dag gi rgyud 'dzin yim2006 4 5la bris/19
le'u gnyis pa/sems kyi kha btags/lus pomo 'di nyam chung yang /sems dmar po la 'gyur ba dben/sems kyi kha/ btags/ drang bden stong gi gnas tshang bsnyegasanasabaslebs yo nga /

mchod pa'i me togaris med 'gro ba'i mgon po//skyes mchog bstan 'dzin snyan grags//me tog sna brgya'i mchod pa//khyed la skyes su phul yod//dad ldan sems kyi sgron me//'ja' lus grub pa'i mkhan chen//lhag bsam sprin gyi mchod pa//khyed la skyes su phul yod//nyam chung gzhon nu nga yis//snying khong rus pa'i gting nas//lhad med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa//khyed la skyes su phul yod//mdo sngags bstan pa'i srog shing //thub bstan bstan 'dzin snyan grags//sku tshe ri rgyal lhun po//brtan pa'i smon lam 'debs so//21

sems kyi kha btags/lang tsho'i me tog gi 'dab lo//mtho sgang rtswa thang nas rgyas kyang //bden don la rgya yi kha btags//gangs can bod yul la 'bul 'dod//sems pa nyam chung gi bu nga'i//lus po phyugs rjes na yod kyang //snying gtam bdud rtsi yi nying bcud//gangs can bod yul la 'bul 'dod//ma 'ongs bde skyid kyi phyir du//kha ba'i smag rum las brgal te//rigs mthun bya khyu dang lhan du//nyi ma'i sku drung du 'phur 'dod//2007 9 7la bris/

dang semasakyi glu sgra/lhag bsam sprin pa'i klong nas//nyam thag 'gro ba yongs la//byams brtse'i gru char 'bebs mkhan//skyabs rje gtso ru yin song //skya ser pho mo yongs la//dge ba'i legs lam ston pa'i//ma gyur 'gro ba'i mgon po//skyabs rje gtso ru yin song | 'gro drug skyong gi pha ma//sprul mchog skyabs rje gtso ru//'di phyi'i skyid sdug bcol sa//khyed nyid gcig pu yin song //sku mchog skyabs rje gtso ru//khyed sku nyi ma gzhon nu//chos ldan kha ba'i zhing du//bskal brgyar bzhugs pa'i smon lam//23

mnyam rdu 'gro/khyed kyis spobs pa'i rdog bro 'khrab bzhin shog/nga yis la rgya'i rlung rta spur bzhin 'ong //'u gnyis kha ba dkar po'i yul gru nas|ma 'ongs rgyal kha 'tshol bar mnyam du 'gro//khyed kyis rig pa'i gad rgyangs sgrog bzhin shog/nga yis brtson pa'i me lce spar bzhin 'ong //'u gnyis rjes lus mun pa'i klung rum nas//ma 'ongs shes bya 'tshol bar mnyam du 'gro//khyed kyis bod mi'i bde sdug gleng bzhin shog/nga yis mes po'i mdzad rjes skyong bzhin 'ong //'u gnyis dka' sdug ri chu'i bsnol mtshams nas//ma 'ongs bde skyid 'tshol bar mnyam du 'gro//khyed kyis mdza' brtse'i glu sgra gtong bzhin shog/nga yis mthun sgril zam pa skrun bzhin 'ong //'u gnyis nang dme'i khrag gi g.yul sa nas//ma 'ongs zhi bde 'tshol bar mnyam du 'gro//24

semasakyi rang sgra/nga'i sems na a ma'i lhag bsam yod//nga'i sems na a pha'i bslab bya yod//nga'i sems na pha ma'i bka' drin yod//nga'i sems na byams brtse'i 'od dkar yod//nga'i sems na yangs pa'i rtswa thang yod//nga'i sems na rta nor lug gsum yod//nga'i sems na rdza chu'i bzhur sgra yod//nga'i sems na dzi bo'i las dbang yod//nga'i sems na grogs po'i mdza' brtse yod//nga'i sems na mdza' mo'i gsang gtam yod//nga'i sems na 'gyur med dam bca' yod//nga'i sems na dran pa'i dbyangs rta yod//nga'i sems na rig pa'i lha mo yod//nga'i sems na brtson pa'i chu bo yod//nga'i sems na shes bya'i me tog yod//nga'i sems na spobs pa'i dbyar rnga yod//25
nga'i sems na rgyang bzhud lha bya yod//nga'i sems na gangs yul 'jol mo yod//nga'i sems na re sgug lo zla yod//nga'i sems na skyo ba'i na zug yod//

nga tsho'i 'gro rogs/kha yi pha skad gtsang ma gcig/khog gi rigs zhen la rgya gnyis//lus kyi 'brog pa'i lwa ba gsum//nga dang bod mi'i 'gro rogs yin//slob dpon dam pa'i zhal gsung gcig/rgyab kyi dpe khug chung chung gnyis//lag gi smyug chung phra mo gsum//nga dang slob ma'i 'gro rogaglakleyin//ri kha'i rdzi glu snyan mo gcig/gsal byed dbyangs rtar 'dren pa gnyis//dpe klog skyor sbyong byed pa gsum//nga dang slob ma'i 'gro rogs yin//rta nor lug gsum 'tsho bklegacig/lus kyi phying dkar lwa ba khonyis//lag gi 'ur cha phra mo gsum//nga dang rdzi bo'i 'gro rogs yin//2007 11 4la bris/27

dran mgur/spang sngon mo g.yu yi gdan steng nas//phyugs rdzi bo'i dbyangs rta lhod kyis 'then//lug dkar chung gar la rtsen pa'i tshe//ngas chung grogs sgrol ma'i rdzi glu dran//nags g.yu lo rgyas pa'i skyed tshal nas//bya khu byug sngon mos skad snyan sgrog/shwa ri dwags rtsed 'jor rol ba'i tshe//ngas chung grogs sgrol ma'i snying gtam dran//dal lhung lhung 'bab pa'i gtsang 'gram du//dbyar chu skyes pad ma'i 'dab lo rgyas//g.yu sbrang ma skyid la rol ba'i tshe//ngas chung grogs sgrol ma'i brtse dung dran//2006 6 5la bris/28

tshe ring sgrol ma/snying grogs tshe ring sgrol ma red//dung ba'i snying gtam gleng sa red//brjed med sems kyi na zug red//gangs phrug nga yi dran shing red//snying grogs tshe ring sgrol ma red//sems pa mi 'gyur brtan po red//lang tsho'i me tog yag po red//gangs phrug nga yi sems rten red//snying grogs tshe ring sgrol ma red//dmar chung sems pa 'khreng sa red//dran pa'i 'phrin chung skur sa red//gangs phrug nga yi zhen sa red//snying grogs tshe ring sgrol ma red//kun yid 'phrog pa'i mdzes ma red//mdo khams bu mo'i dwangs rtse red//gangs phrug nga yi gtan grogs red//29

do nub kyi phyir dran/snying grogs bu mor bral ba'i kher rkyang bu ngas//sngar gyi 'das don phyogs la bsam gzhigs byed tshe//kho mos bshad pa'i sems kyi snying gtam dmar po//nga yi sems kyi sge'u khung ngogs su shar 'ong //skar mas khong 'dar byed pa'i mtshan mo 'di ru//stong 'dang rkyang rkyang zhig gi bzi kha'i khrod du//pir shog lag tu bzung ste bsam gzhigs byas mthar//snyan ngag gsar ba zhig gi brjod bya rnyed byung //dmigs yul gcig la gtad pa'i phyir dran klong nas//skyo sdug mig chu bzhur bzhin snyan ngag bris kyang //do nub zhag sgron ngogs kyi kher lab rkyang ba//phan tshun grogs la brjod pa'i spobs pa mi 'dug/mgo bo sngas la ma bzhag nam phyed 'das song //gam gyi zhag sgron mi gsal nub la nye 'dug/kher rkyang sems pa rum nas gnyid du yur yang //rmi lam skyid po zhig gi bden kha ma byin//30

skyo sems/a sngon nam mkha'i mthongs na//sprin pa yar 'gro mar 'gro//snying grogs zla ba gzhon nu//ma mthong sems pa skyo song //tshang tshing nags klung khrod na//byi'u chung phar 'phur tshur 'phur//snying grogs khu byug sngon mo//ma mthong sems pa skyo song //dwangs gsal g.yu mtsho'i kha na//ngang chung phar 'phur tshur 'phur//snying grogs gser mig nya chung //ma mthong sems pa skyo song //mar bltas gzhung lam steng na//'grul ba brgya 'gro stong 'gro//snying grogs skal bzang sgrol ma//ma mthong sems pa skyo song //31

sring chung ma/las dbang btsan po zhig gi bkod sgrig 'og/rgyus med gnas yul 'grim pa'i sring chung ma//khor yug ljang mdog/rgyas pa'i dus tshigs 'dir//drin chen pha mar bral nas gnas la bskyal//bcu drug lang tsho rgyas pa'i sring chung ma//khyed rang gnas la bskyal ba'i nyin mo 'dir//nga dang pha ma'i sems pa skyo bzhin du//mig chu dron mo zhig gis skyel ma byas//byams ldan pha ma gnyis kyi brtse 'dzum khrod//lang tsho'i gnyom lag rgyas pa'i sring chung ma//g.yu sngon mtsho mo 'khyil 'dra'i pha yul nas//sdod dbang med par gnas yul 'grim dgos byung //sdug bsngal lci mo zhig gi mnar gcod 'og/gom kha yul gzhan bsgyur ba'i sring chung ma//ming chung nga rang skyo ba'i dbyangs rta 'di//dung so dkar po bsgrigs pa'i phreng las shor//32

bslu brid/le lo phag pas khyed rang bslus//rnam g.yeng bu mos nga rang bslus//bslu brid rlung bu'i so kha na//shes bya'i sgron me gzim la nye//phrag dog 'dre mos khyed rang bslus//nga rgyal gdon mos nga rang bslus//bslu brid ston kha'i sdong rtse na//rang gshis lo 'dab lhung la nye//a rag bdud rtsis khyed rang bslus//tha mag du bas nga rang bslus//bslu brid sprin pa'i grib 'og na/mi tshe'i dbugs rgyun chad la nye//gzhan skad tsub mos khyed rang bslus//dus gsar lwa bas nga rang bslus//bslu brid bye ma'i thang dkyil na//mes po'i zhabs rjes bsub la nye//33

lug rdzi bu mo/g.yang dkar gyi lug khyu'i rjes na//dran gdung gi glu gzhas gyer ba'i//rtswa thang gi lug rdzi bu mo//bdag sems kyi dran shing khyod red//lhung lhungagi rdza chu'i 'gram na//gnag snum gyi skra lo shad pa'i// rtswa thang gi lug rdzi bu mo//bdag sems kyi na zug khyod red//ljang mdog gi rtswa thang khrod na//'jo sgeg gi lang tsho ngom pa'i//yid 'ong gi lug rdzi bu mo/bdag sems kyi mdzes sdug khyod red//char ba dang smug long khrod na//bal ldan gyi lug khyu 'tshol ba'i//rtswa thang gi lug rdzi bu mo//bdag sems kyi dung ba khyod red//34

gangs ri'i ljongs kyi dar rgud/skya rengs snang bas mkha' mtha' gsal ba yi ljongs 'dir//tshan rtsal rig pa'i me tog lhug lhug tu bzhad kyang //pha skad gtsang ma'i mtsho la dar kha zhig bsgrigs pas//bu ngas dar rgud mthong ba'i glu chung re len 'dod//mkhas mdzangs mang du byon pa'i kha ba yi ljongs 'dir//ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i khang bzang re bskrun yang //pha mes re sbra smug po dus rlung gis khur bas//bu ngas dar rgud mthong ba'i gleng mol re byed 'dod//chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs pa'i bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'dir//rlangs 'khor 'phrul 'khor spyod pa'i dus bzang zhig bslebs kyang //rta pho'i gom sgra dus kyis rgyang ring du spur bas//bu ngas dar rgud mthong ba'i snyan tshig re 'bri 'dod//dkar nag phyugs rigs skyong ba'i sbra nag gi yul 'dir//pho mo'i mig dbang 'phrog pa'i lwa gsar re dar yang //bod pa'i rang lwa bzang bo gyon mkhan ni nyung bas//bu ngas dar rgud mthong ba'i bgro gleng re byed 'dod//35
le'u gsum pa/rkang rjes dmar po/'brong g.yag gi rmig sgra lasamago pa'i/bsub med kyi dan rtags dmar po/)sde zur cis :gor+sār rjeskyed ya/ phyar ga nya sar ba ngas pa'i dar cha mthon po/

rkang rjes dmar po/ ngas dran 'dzin gyi thang chen brgyud de/dka' sdug gi rngul chus bskrun pa'i/rkang rjes dmar po/brtson pa dang rgyal kha'i khrod/mi yul 'dir phab pa/dwangs gtsang gi sems pa yin/rkang rjes dmar skre/phrag dog gi dug rlung dang /mi kha yi grang reg ji ltar rgod kyang /la rgya dang spobs pa yi dbang gis/sems pa 'di phyi ru mngon/ rkang rjes dmar po/mun nag gi btsan rdzong dang /pha yul gyi ri chu brgal dus/ ngas khyed kyi lang tsho rnyed/37

rten 'brel gyi mchod pa/da wagrogs phur ba 'phrin las la/bkra shis nyi ma bzang po ri rtser 'phags shing /spro dga'i me tog gsar ba'i 'dab ma grol dus/grogs po lags/ngas zungs khrag gi dwangs ma re re'i/khyed la rten 'brel gyi mchod pa 'bul/rmad byung gnam lo gsar ba mgron du bsus shing /skyid pa'i glu sgra snyan mo lhang lhang grags dus/grogs po lags/ jings smyu gu dang 'bri shog bzung nas/khyed la rten 'brel gyi snyan tshig 'bri/sna mang zhal zas 'dzoms pa'i sder kha bsgrigs shing /ngo mtshar glu— dang gar gyi rtsed mo byed dus/grogs po lags/ ngas ku re dang snying gtam khrod du/khyed la rten 'brel gyi rtsed chang 'bul/38

brtse ba'i chagasa'ajigs 'dzin ma'i lwa dkar gyon zhing /gtsang bo la 'khyag rom chags 'dugadagun zla der/ 'u gnyis kyi brtse ba dwangs ma zhig la/dbu khyud bris dus der/phan tshun la snying gtam brjod myong la/dung sems kyang chags myong /'on kyang /dus tshod kyi dbang gis/bde skyid kyi lhing 'jags dkrogs te/sdug yus lci mo zhig dang lhan du/'bral dgos byung /de bas/ lo 'ga'i ring la/khyed kyi mdzes shing sdug pa'i lang tsho dang /snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i snying gtam/ngas ci yang ma thos/snying sdug ma/khyed kyis rma klung sngon mo'i 'gyur khugs khrod/nga la re sgug byas yod dam/39

rlung khrod kyi sems pa/lus po rlung khrod du gnas shing /sems pa grang rlung gis gtses/rlung bu 'di 'tshub drag pas/nga'i sems pa 'khyag la shor/'khyag sib sib kyi sems pa 'di rum nas/ gnyom dung dung gi glu gzhas 'di gyer dus/nga'i sems pa/ras rkyang dmar po zhig gi/drod khol la dung /red ya/las dbang gi lha mos/dung sems kyi kha dog ma bsgyur na/nga rang /dug mtsho 'di'i pha rol dang /rlung bu 'di'i so kha las/brgal thub par sems/2006 12 3nyin/40

gangs phrug khyu gcig gi spobasapa/kho tshos rtswa thang 'dir/'od 'tsher ba'i mar me zhig sgron slad/mdun bskyod kyi rdog bro 'khrab kyin/dus gsar gyi mkha' ru bskyod/red ya grogs po tsho/gangs phrug 'di tshos/rang cag gi la rgya'am ma 'ongs pa'i bde skyid ched/rnam shes rmas ma zhig gi 'phur lding byed bzhin/dus rabs kyi dkyogs mtshams re nas/mgo bo btsan gyis dgye zhing /gom pa shugs kyis spos/ phugs bsam la gson shugs rgyas pa'i/gangs phrug 'di tshos/rtswa thang na rjes su lus pa'i/nga dang rdzi bo skor zhig la/shes rig gi 'od snang bstsal zhing /mdun bskyod kyi bgrod lam zhig kyang bstan myong /41

'tsho ba'i ljang mdoga.a khu'i bka' drin/le dbar khri phrag gi mtshams na/'khreng zhen dang phyi migapha yul du shor ba'i/65 khugā 95gas/nga dang nga'i pha ma/da dung ming sring tsho/nor gnag gi rmig rjes dang /rjes lus kyi mun pa'i khrod du/dbul phongs kyis 'tsho/ yin na'ang da lta/ dus rabs kyi 'od snang dang /khyed kyi bka' drin gyis/skya thang nger yod pa'i dbul khyim 'di la/ljang mdog gi mdzes sdug bskrun yod/a khu shā5gas/nga'i mi tshe la rdzogs tshig 'bri rag bar/bskyal zin pa'i 'tsho ba dang /khyed kyi bka' drin brjed mi srid/42
a khu lags/nga'i sems khong na drod lam mer 'khyil ba ni/khyed kyi bslab bya yin la/mig gong las 'khyag sib ber lhung ba ni/gyes kha'i mig chu yin/

bzhud la nye ba'i sbra nag/srid pa'i g.yang gzar na/gzi brjid kyis 'gyings pa'i/sbra nag lags/khyed ni mes po'i lo rgyus yin la/mtho sgang gi mdzes sdug kyang yin/de bas/nga tsho ni khyed kyi thu 'og nas nar son pa'i/ming sring zhig gam/ yang na/rigs rgyud gcig las mched pa'i/mi rigs shig kyang yin/yin na'ang / khyed rang /dus rabs 'di'i rlung kha na/bzhud la nye bas/nga tsho'i sems la/skyo sdug gi rma kha bzos pa/thengs gcig min/sbra nag lags/ nga tshos/khyed rang nyen kha 'di nas skyob nges yin/44

gshog mthun bya khyu/grogs po tshor phul/ gshog mthun bya khyu/spang ljongs dang me tog khrod nas/'dzum mdangs dang dgod sgra bcas te/lhan du 'dzoms/ gshog mthun bya khyu/lhan 'dzoms kyi dus tshigs med na/spro skyid kyi dbyar zla zhig kyang med/ gshog mthun bya khyu/ da dung /mdza' mthun gyi gshog zung brkyangs te/drod lam lam gyi snying gtam khyer nas/rang rang gi gnas la 'phur song /gshog mthun bya khyu/ gyes bral gyi sdug yus lci mo/ gshog zung gis khur nas/re sgug khri phrag dang lhan du gnas/45

gshed ma nag po/rgyu 'bras dang gnas lugs med pa'i/srin po'i dbang 'og na/nyam chung ngang 'tsho ba'i/srog ldan khyed tsho snying re rje/nga tshos rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i phyir du/khyed tsho'i tshe srog gi rmu thag bcad pa/thengs gcig ga la yin/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃḥ ya nga ba'i 'tsho stangs 'dis/yul dkar po 'di khrag la bsgyur/bsam gzhigs re byas rjes/ nga la skrag snang zhig dang /'gyod sems shig gang ltar/nga dang dpung tshogs 'di/khyed tsho'i tshe srog gi gshed ma red/

grogs po tsho/ mdun du bskyod ciga'agro ya grogs po tsho/yab mes kyi mdzad rjes skyong bzhin/byams brtse dang la rgya khur te/dus rabs kyi nyi gzhon bsu ru 'gro/'gro ya grogs po tsho/mdun bskyod kyi glu gzhas gyer ba'i/rjes lus kyi gom kha bsgyur te/dus rabs kyi nyi gzhon bsu ru 'gro/'gro ya grogs po tsho/dmu rgod kyi rang gshis spang ste/zhi bde yi skya rengs dang lhan du/dus rabs kyi nyi gzhon bsu ru 'gro/'gro ya grogs po tsho/brtson 'grus kyi chu bor brgal zhing /rmi lam gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs te/dus rabs kyi nyi gzhon bsu ru 'gro/47

do nub kyi rmi lam /mtshan mo 'dir/ gangs dkar gyi phang ba na/nor lug gi mtha' 'khor na/nga tsho gnyid du yur 'dugaskabs der/sgo khyi'i zug skad dang / —spyang gi'i ngu zug sogs/ brag char 'khor yang / nga tsho/gti mug gi zhing khams na/bde sdug gi bsnol mtshams na/skabs rer bde skyid kyis 'tsho zhing /lan rer dka' sdug gis bskyod/mtshan mo 'dir/ —rmi lam khri phrag gi sgo them brgal rgyu ma gtogs/ci'i phyir/ nga tsho sad ma thub/

gnasa'agro ma'i lasadabang /grang ngar dang rlung 'tshub rgod sa'i/'jig rten dog mo zhig na/las dbang gi dar lcog zad po/rlung kha ru bskyod pa'i/gnas 'gro ma tsho/khyed tshos/ rang dbang med pa'i 'jig rten zhig nas/yid gtod med pa'i khyim gzhi zhig gi slad du/lag mdzub la ser ga gas rag bar/ma 'ongs pa'i bde skyid la bsgugaganas 'gro ma tsho/nga'i sring chung tsho dang khyed tshos/pham kha 'di khur nas/mig chu 'di rum nas/'tsho dgos pa las dbang red/2006 10 2la bris/49

pha sagangasakyi ra ba/rngam brjid gangs ri'i gzi dpal 'bar sa//seng khyu stong gi 'tsho gzhes gnang sa//rma rgyal 'brong gi ngur sgra thos//'u cag bod pa'i pha sa yin song //rma klong sngon mo dal gyis 'bab sa//dwangs gtsang 'bri chu bzhur rgyun ring sa//rma 'bri gnyis kyis lhing 'jags dkrogs sa//'u cag bod pa'i pha sa yin song //srol rgyun rig pa'i me tog bzhad sa//pha skad gtsang ma'i rol dbyangs snyan sa//lhag bsam dkar po'i rang mdangs mngon sa//'u cag bod pa'i pha sa yin song //mi rigs dar rgyas las don sgrub sa//bsam blo'i kha phyogs chos la bsgyur sa//rigs zhen zab mo'i glu sgra thos sa//'u cag bod pa'i pha sa yin song //50

sgo khyi'i lasadabang /grang reg kha bas lus po gtses kyang //skyo ba'i mig chu rum du bcug nas//'chor med lcags thag 'dom gang sne na//las dbang gnyom po rlung la bskyon 'dug/mngar ldan zas mchog za myong med pas//lto rtsam thug pa zhim snang shar 'dug/drod khol snyegs sa'i khang khyim med pas//char rlung khrod na grang 'dar byas 'dug/khyim bdag la la snying rje med pas//sgo khyi'i 'tsho ba skyo bor gyur 'dug/'di ltar 'tsho ba'i sgo khyi bsams na//dmar chung sems pa bde thabs mi 'dug/las dbang ngan pa'i mnar gcod khur ba'i//dom nag khyi yi 'tsho stangs sdug po//nyam chung bu nga'i pir smyug rtse las// 'di ltar babs pa mig chu'i tshab yin//51

semasakyi me tog tshom bu/dar rgyas don 'grub/lhad med gshis ka'i me tog dmar po//grogs po stong gi sems na mdzes shing //mgo yi lhan skyes skra lo ring bo//rmad byung lang tsho'i rgyan du mngon 'dug/'bum phyug rgyal/mu med sngo ljang rtswa thang zhig nas//snyan 'gyur ngag gi dbyangs rta btus te//spro tshogs shig la dbu khyud bris pa//nga tshor phul ba'i legs skyes yin 'dug/'phags skyabs/ 'grul bzhud bsam blo'i 'phur stangs khrod nas//pi wang dkar bo'i dbyangs rta rnyed pas//〈〈mchod pa'i me tog 〉〉glu ru gyer nas//mdun bskyod gom sgra rgyang nas thos 'ong //kun ldan༄la/gso ba rig pa'i me tog bcud la//52

lhod med ro'itshoba'i bung ba gzhon nus//chag gsum 'og nas rtsa la— brtag ste//'byung gzhi'i nad la pham kha ster 'dod//byams pa mtha' yas/rig pa'i lha mo 'dzum gyis bsu bzhin//dkar 'jam shog dkar gru bzhi'i ngos la//brjod bya legs pa'i rtsom re bris kyang //dmangs khrod gzhas la dung sha rtsen 'dug/lha dar/thos 'dzin rna ba'i gsos su smin pa'i//mgrin pa'i lam gyi mdza' gzhas re re//'phrul rta'i gong nas rlung la bskur bas//sman shar stong gi dung sems bkug song //bkra shis dbang phyug/byis pa'i dus su g.yang dkar rjes nas//ku re gtam gleng mod po byed kyin//mnyam du bskyal pa'i 'tsho ba snum po//bdag sems dmar bo'i srubs kar 'tshang 'dug/bsod sgye/gsar skyes lang tsho'i ljon pa bzang bo//me 'obs khrod du sreg la byas kyang //bzod bsran am gtsigs drag tu bsdams nas//mngar skyur 'tsho ba'i bro ba myong 'dug/53

blo bzang dgelpegs/mun stug 'khor ba'i rdzob las langs te//gom kha ngur smrig gling du bsgyur ba'i//btsun chung khyod kyi gom 'gros de la//bu ngas smon pa thengs gcig shor 'dug/rdortse/dus gsar lwa bas lang tshor brgyan pa'i//grogs mchog khyod kyi brtse ba'i me tog/sprel nag 'khyam pa'i snying gi dbus nas//nam yang mi skam 'dzum gyis bzhad 'dug/bkra shis rgyal/mag mog 'tsho ba'i lam kha zhig nas//bden don skad cha rnon por smra yang //nor 'khrul 'obs su thengs gcig lhung bas//pham kha'i khur bo phrag tu babs 'dug/54

lasadabang gi 'tsho grogs/nga mgar zhol sprel nag 'khyam po yin// mgar rtswa thang nga yi pha yul yin//rta nor lug nga yi 'tsho rten yin//rgyab slog pa nga yi gyon pa yin//nga mgar zhol sprel nag 'khyam po yin//lha 'jam dpal nga yi grogs lha yin//gsung dhi yig nga yi kha 'don yin//nang bstan chos nga yi bsgrub bya yin//nga mgar zhol sprel nag 'khyam po yin//gangs dkar po nga yi sems 'dzin yin//seng dkar mo nga yi skyo grogs yin//bod gangs can nga yi snying nor yin//nga mgar zhol sprel nag 'khyam po yin//sbra mthing smrag nga yi sdod khang yin//zas rtsam pa nga yi kha zas yin//skad yi ge nga yi bslab bya yin//55

mirtag rgyu ma'i lang tsho/mthon mthing mu mtha' bral ba'i lha lam gyi ngogs na//gser mdog 'od zhags 'khyug pa'i rta bdun gyi dbang bo//ris med 'gro ba yongs kyi bde skyid du shar yang //srod kha'i grib ma nag po'i 'jigs rngam gyis khyer 'gro//sngo ljang g.yu lo bkra ba'i spang thang gi dbus na//skyed tshal bkrag mdangs bral ba'i me tog gi lang tsho//drug ldan g.yu sbrang gzhon nu'i sems 'dzin du snang yang //ston gsum sad nag ser ba'i gdug tsub gyis khyer 'gro//rlabs phreng chem chem g.yo ba'i mtsho mo yi klong gi/gshog drug lto dkar nya mo'i 'khyug rtsal gyi gar stabs//sgro ldan mtsho bya ngang ba'i mdzes sdug tu bsgom yang //dgun gsum 'khyag rom dar gyi rngam shugs kyis khyer 'gro//sna tshogs rgyan chas spras pa'i mi tshogs kyi khrod na//lang tsho'i 'phyor sgeg ngom pa'i sman chung gi zhal la//na chung gzhon nu dag gi dung sems de 'khor yang //de ni mi rtag lo rgas gnyer ma yis khyer 'gro//56

me tshe zhig gi brgyud rim/byis dus zla ba 'dzin par ham sems 'khor//byis dus sa rdo gnyis kyis rtse ra bskrun//byis dus dbyug par zhon nas rkang rtsal 'gran//byis dus rtsed mor rnam par g.yeng bar dga'//gzhon dus lang tsho'i gzi dpal 'bar bzhin mchis//gzhon dus rang snang mthon po mkha' ru 'phur//gzhon dus sems pa dmar po grogs la chags//gzhon dus mi kha'i rlung dmar rjes su 'khor//rgas dus mgo skyes skra lo dkar por gyur//rgas dus gdong la mi mdzes gnyer ma bkra//rgas dus so phreng dkar po rim bzhin thor//rgas dus lus kyi ljon pa nang du sgur//'chi dus lus po bzod med na bas gzir//'chi dus mi yul skyid po gyes la ran//'chi dus mchog gsum byin mthu snying la bsgom//'chi dus chags zhen mig zung phyi ru shor//57

bod pa'i mdzesam/gshis rgyud bzang ba'i mdzes ma//phyi thag ring ba'i mdzes ma//dung sems 'khor ba'i mdzes ma—/mtho sgang bod pa'i mdzes ma//pha mar byams pa'i mdzes ma//byams sems ldan pa'i mdzes ma//kun yid 'phrog pa'i mdzes ma/mtho sgang bod pa'i mdzes ma//blo sgo yangs pa'i mdzes ma/ngag sgo 'jam pa'i mdzes ma//bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i mdzes ma//mtho sgang bod pa'i mdzes ma//2006lo'i zla 10tshes 22nyin/58

rnam shesadang bem po/rnam shes ya/khyed kyis 'khreng zhen gyi mig chu 'don gyin/'jig rten 'di'i yod tshad cig la/rdzogs tshig bkod nas/lam du chas dgos/gang ltar/ tshe srog gi rnam shes gson po/bem por bral rjes/shul du lus pa'i bem po/rgod po khyu gcig gi gsol ston du gyur 'dugade nas bzung /nyam thag pa'i rnam shes de/rgyang du bzhud/59

yi/pha semab/ma skyo/lo zla tsub mo zhig gi brgyud rim khrod na/skra lo yi kha dog yal zhing /so phreng gi sgrig rim thor zin/de bas nga'i a pha'i/sems 'gyu yod tshad/'jig rten 'di'i pha rol la shor/yin na'ang /a pha sems ma skyo/gnas 'di nas/lhan 'dzoms kyi dus tshod ring na/nga tshos khyed la/bde skyid kyi 'od snang gsar ba zhig dang /mdzes sdug gi 'tsho ba snum po zhigacis kyang bskrun nges/2002lo'i zla 8tshes 28nyin/60

mjug gtam/rnam dpyod rig pa'i 'dab brgya grol zhing snyan ngag lha mor dung ba zab pa'i snying nye ba'i klog mkhan tsho/ bdag gis mi lo lnga yi ring la gnag phyugs kyi rmig rjes las btsal ba'i 〈〈rkang rjes dmar po 〉〉zhes pa'i snyan deb chung chung 'di ‘‘kha btags chung rung lha rdzas dang gur gum nyung yang sman rdzas ’ zhes pa'i dpe ltar byams ldan pha ma'i bka' drin gyi zur tsam 'jal phyir dang /mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar bar brten nas bod rigs spun zla rnams la legs skyes su phul ba yin/ lhag par du/snyan deb 'di'i 'go mjug bar gsum la mdzub ston gnang ba'i grogs mgar 'bum phyug rgyal la'ang snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu/ bdag gi lhan skyes kyi rig pa rtul zhing sbyang stobs kyi brtson pa zhan pas deb chung 'dir skyon mi nyung ba zhig kyang mchis srid pas/ khyed cag gis mdzub ston re gnang rogs zhu/61

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ sgrol ma skyabs/deb gzhi'ijus 'god pa/ sgrol ma/rkang rjes dmar pokadape sgrun mkhan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang /'grems thekhi mkhan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi bod yig rtsom sgrig khang /gnas yul/ pe cin grong khyer ho phing li byang lam ang 14pa/sbrag angaka 100013kha para.ang grangs/ 010—64227665—6508brgyad 'chong mkhan/ rgyal yongs sa gnas so so'i zhin hwa dpe tshong khang /par bsgrigs mkhan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi skul 'od par sgrig khang /snar 'debs mkhan/ dbyi hu'e par 'debs khang /༵dṛ r+shar+sha/ 7spra7sgroli྾1092tshal 1phro32par gzhi'i sgrig thengs/ 2008lo'i zla 6par par gzhi 1po bsgrigs/par thengs/ 2008lo'i zla 6par par thengs 1po brgyab/snasna snatā sna/ra/ ཿ/—15kro
